result.summary: Overall the page renders cleanly. A few minor issues: truncated restaurant name in the horizontally scrolling carousel, placeholder-looking generic food illustrations that may read as unfinished, and low-contrast text on the dark promo-adjacent cards.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge with a truncated name and partially clipped '20-30 min' badge, giving an unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-side fade/gradient or adequate padding/peek spacing so partially visible cards look intentional and names are less awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: Restaurant thumbnails appear to be generic placeholder illustrations (plate, burger, ramen bowl) rather than real photos, which can look visually inconsistent with real content.
issues.suggestion: Replace with actual restaurant photography, or style placeholders consistently with clear branding so they don't appear as missing images.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on dark image backgrounds is low contrast (dark gray on dark photo), making it hard to see and tap-target ambiguous.
issues.suggestion: Increase icon contrast (white icon with subtle shadow/outline) and ensure a minimum 44x44pt touch target.

issues.description: Bottom navigation label 'Search' duplicates the search bar already prominent at the top of the home screen, which is slightly redundant.
issues.suggestion: Consider differentiating the nav entry (e.g., 'Browse' or categories) or keeping it, but ensure it navigates to a distinct search experience.
